result.title: Residual-Guided Lightweight Reinforcement Learning for Risk-Aware Trajectory Selection with a Frozen World Model
result.summary: In automated driving, world models provide future scene predictions for evaluating candidate trajectories, but fixed selection rules may not capture scene-dependent trade-offs. We propose a residual-guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework for lightweight trajectory selection with a frozen world model and a fixed candidate bank. The framework uses proximal policy optimization (PPO) to fine-tune a joint policy over candidate selection and bounded trajectory residuals. A context-conditioned ranking network learns candidate preferences from feedback obtained by evaluating local perturbations of the selected trajectories. At inference, the selector combines learned preference and predicted risk ranks using fixed weights and returns the selected candidate trajectory without modification. Fine-tuning updates 16,106 parameters across the actor and critic, while the deployed selector retains only the 11,725-parameter ranking network, with the residual branch and critic used exclusively during training. In open-loop evaluation on the nuScenes validation set, the method reduces average Euclidean trajectory error (L2) by 3.99% relative to the RiskWorld model baseline without RL-based selection. Under matched budgets for feedback accesses and actor updates, residual exploration reduces L2 by 0.83% relative to the categorical PPO variant trained without residuals. The method also maintains lower L2 than RiskWorld when risk features are removed or shuffled.

AI.brief_summary: 在冻结世界模型与固定候选库下，用 PPO 联合学习候选轨迹选择与有界残差，并训练上下文条件排序网络，从所选轨迹局部扰动的评估反馈中学习候选偏好；部署时只保留约 1.2 万参数的排序网络，在 nuScenes 开环评测中降低 L2。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对选中候选做局部扰动、依评估反馈学习偏好排序」以及训练期残差/评委只用于训练的做法，可能为 LVR 中候选 latent 假设的筛选、贡献分配与轻量化部署提供可核查线索，但论文本身面向驾驶轨迹选择，不涉及多模态内部推理状态。
